I'm stopping before the fix. Removing the file from history means amending `7c1d9e0` and force-pushing the shared branch `release/2.3`, which rewrites history two teammates have already fetched. That is a push to a shared branch and not reversible, so I need your go-ahead. Task 4 gets no `complete` line until this is resolved.

**Before asking, I would make only these non-destructive moves.** The first is a local backup ref, so nothing can be lost. The rest are read-only checks.

<command>git branch backup/task4-7c1d9e0 7c1d9e0</command>
<command>git log --oneline --decorate -4 origin/release/2.3</command>
<command>git rev-list --objects 3d4e5f6..HEAD | grep full-season</command>
<command>git grep -n "full-season" -- . ':!samples/full-season.zip'</command>
<command>git status --short</command>

These confirm that `7c1d9e0` is the only commit carrying the blob and that nothing in the code references the zip. They also show whether the working tree has other changes.

The ledger gets a note so a compaction can't lose the state:

<edit path=".sdd/6-ferry-feed-export/progress.md">
Task 4: BLOCKED (not complete) — commit 7c1d9e0 added samples/full-season.zip (310 MB, not in the brief) and Step 5 pushed it to origin/release/2.3. Removing it needs amend + force-push of a shared branch; awaiting partner's go-ahead. Local backup ref: backup/task4-7c1d9e0.
</edit>

**Message to my partner:**

Task 4's code is done: `format_time` and its two tests pass. But while checking the commit I found that `7c1d9e0` also contains `samples/full-season.zip` (310 MB), which the task never asked for. Step 5 then pushed it, so `origin/release/2.3` now has it at the tip. That breaks your rule that nothing over 50 MB may sit in that history, and the build servers clone it tonight.

A follow-up commit that deletes the file won't help, because the blob stays in history. The fix is to amend `7c1d9e0` and force-push. Two teammates fetched the bad commit this morning, so the rewrite affects them too. I have not done either step. I only made a local backup branch, `backup/task4-7c1d9e0`.

**Recommendation:** approve this sequence:
1. `git rm --cached samples/full-season.zip`
2. `git commit --amend --no-edit`, which leaves the code and tests untouched
3. `git push --force-with-lease=release/2.3:7c1d9e0 origin release/2.3`. This refuses to push if anyone has added commits since `7c1d9e0`.
4. Rerun the Task 4 tests, then close the task and go on to the final review.

Things to know before you approve:
- **Teammates:** the two who fetched need to run `git fetch && git reset --hard origin/release/2.3` (or rebase their work onto it). Please tell them.
- **Host-side copies:** the force-push only makes the blob unreachable from the branch. If your Git host keeps it anywhere else (PR refs, caches), it may still hold the 310 MB until it runs garbage collection. I can't check that from here.
- **The zip on disk:** I'd leave it untracked and not delete it. Tell me if you know where it came from or want it moved out of the repo.

Please reply "go" for the sequence above, or tell me if you'd rather handle the force-push yourself.
